content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a good day. Before I sign the agreement, I would like to propose a small adjustment. - Regarding the payment terms in the relevant clause, a ninety-day period causes a significant delay in receiving funds, so I propose changing it to: The second installment of $115,250.00 shall be paid Net 30 days from the Effective Date of this Agreement. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
